// @effect-v3
import { Duration, Effect } from "effect"

export const numericZero = Effect.yieldNow()
export const positiveZero = Effect.sleep(+0)
export const negativeZero = Effect.sleep(-0)
export const decimalZero = Effect.sleep(0.0)
export const exponentZero = Effect.sleep(0e3)
export const hexadecimalZero = Effect.sleep(0x0)
export const binaryZero = Effect.sleep(0b0)
export const octalZero = Effect.sleep(0o0)
export const bigintZero = Effect.sleep(0n)
export const negativeBigintZero = Effect.sleep(-0n)
export const hexadecimalBigintZero = Effect.sleep(0x0n)
export const parenthesizedZero = Effect.sleep(((0)))
export const assertedZero = Effect.sleep(0 as number)
export const satisfiesZero = Effect.sleep(0 satisfies number)
export const tupleZero = Effect.sleep([0, 0])
export const signedTupleZero = Effect.sleep([-0, +0])
export const assertedTupleZero = Effect.sleep([0, 0] as const)
export const stringZero = Effect.sleep("0 seconds")
export const signedStringZero = Effect.sleep("-00.00 seconds")
export const templateZero = Effect.sleep(`0 millis`)
export const nanosStringZero = Effect.sleep("0 nanos")
export const microsStringZero = Effect.sleep("0 micros")
export const decimalNanosString = Effect.sleep("0.0 nanos")
export const decimalMicrosString = Effect.sleep("0.0 micros")
export const singularNanoZero = Effect.sleep("0 nano")
export const singularMicroZero = Effect.sleep("0 micro")
export const singularMilliZero = Effect.sleep("0 milli")
export const singularSecondZero = Effect.sleep("0 second")
export const minuteStringZero = Effect.sleep("0 minutes")
export const hourStringZero = Effect.sleep("0 hours")
export const dayStringZero = Effect.sleep("0 days")
export const weekStringZero = Effect.sleep("0 weeks")
export const durationZero = Effect.sleep(Duration.zero)
export const durationNanosZero = Effect.sleep(Duration.nanos(0n))
export const durationMicrosZero = Effect.sleep(Duration.micros(-0n))
export const durationMillisZero = Effect.sleep(Duration.millis(+0))
export const durationSecondsZero = Effect.sleep(Duration.seconds(-0))
export const durationMinutesZero = Effect.sleep(Duration.minutes(0))
export const durationHoursZero = Effect.sleep(Duration.hours(0))
export const durationDaysZero = Effect.sleep(Duration.days(0))
export const durationWeeksZero = Effect.sleep(Duration.weeks(0))
export const nestedYield = Effect.gen(function*() {
  yield* Effect.sleep(0)
})
export const largerExpression = Effect.sleep(0).pipe(Effect.as("ready"))
export const leadingComment = /* yield cooperatively */ Effect.sleep(0) // keep this comment

export const nonzero = Effect.sleep(1)
export const negativeNonzero = Effect.sleep(-1)
export const bigintNonzero = Effect.sleep(1n)
export const infiniteDuration = Effect.sleep(Infinity)
export const notANumber = Effect.sleep(NaN)
export const nonzeroString = Effect.sleep("1 seconds")
export const fractionalString = Effect.sleep("0.1 millis")
export const invalidString = Effect.sleep("0 ms" as Duration.DurationInput)
export const unsupportedUnit = Effect.sleep("0 milliseconds" as Duration.DurationInput)
export const whitespaceSuffix = Effect.sleep("0 seconds " as Duration.DurationInput)
export const leadingWhitespace = Effect.sleep(" 0 seconds" as Duration.DurationInput)
export const nonzeroTuple = Effect.sleep([0, 1])
export const nonzeroConstructor = Effect.sleep(Duration.seconds(1))
const zero = 0
export const constantDuration = Effect.sleep(zero)
export const arithmeticZero = Effect.sleep(1 - 1)
export const substitutedTemplate = Effect.sleep(`${zero} seconds`)
const returnZero = (): 0 => { console.log("evaluated"); return 0 }
const zeroGetter = { get duration(): 0 { console.log("evaluated"); return 0 } }
export const calledDuration = Effect.sleep(returnZero())
export const getterDuration = Effect.sleep(zeroGetter.duration)
export const commaDuration = Effect.sleep((console.log("evaluated"), 0))
export const assertedCall = Effect.sleep(returnZero() as 0)
export const assertedNonzero = Effect.sleep(1 as 0)
export const assertedConstructorNonzero = Effect.sleep(Duration.seconds(1 as 0))
export const calledConstructor = Effect.sleep(Duration.seconds(returnZero()))
export const optionalSleep = Effect.sleep?.(0)
export const optionalModuleSleep = Effect?.sleep(0)
export const optionalDurationConstructor = Effect.sleep(Duration.seconds?.(0))
export const optionalDurationZero = Effect.sleep(Duration?.zero)
export const spreadDuration = Effect.sleep(...[0] as const)
const unrelated = { sleep: (duration: number) => duration, zero: 0, seconds: (duration: number) => duration }
export const unrelatedSleep = unrelated.sleep(0)
export const unrelatedZero = Effect.sleep(unrelated.zero)
export const unrelatedConstructor = Effect.sleep(unrelated.seconds(0))
export const shadowedEffect = ((Effect: typeof unrelated) => Effect.sleep(0))(unrelated)

// @ts-expect-error
export const positiveBigintZero = Effect.sleep(+0n)
// @ts-expect-error
export const extraArgument = Effect.sleep(0, 0)
// @ts-expect-error
export const typeArgument = Effect.sleep<number>(0)
// @ts-expect-error
export const emptyTuple = Effect.sleep([])
// @ts-expect-error
export const holeTuple = Effect.sleep([, 0])
// @ts-expect-error
export const bigintTuple = Effect.sleep([0n, 0n])
// @ts-expect-error
export const spreadTuple = Effect.sleep([...[0], 0])
